item.title: Running HashiCorp MCP Servers as a Shared Kubernetes Service
item.description: If you’ve been following along with my posts on configuring AI tooling for infrastructure work, most of the examples have involved running an MCP server locally. Running a process on your machine with credentials in your environment on a port that only you can reach gets you up and running quickly, which is great for getting started, but has limitations.
